desc: The TAPCO Handgun Cleaning Kit has everything needed to keep handguns at top performance. With a Cuality Rod and accessories that are ideal for a new gun owner and those more experienced shooters who want to refresh their supplies. Includes: Rigid Black Steel Cleaning Rode 6.5in Length with Swivel Handle Rod Extension #8-32 Thread (Clean up to 8in Length Barrels with Additional extension) Double End Nylon Bristle Gun Brush Black Steel Patch Holder Phosphor Bronze Bore Brush Muzzle Guard 2oz CLP Silicone Cloth Cotton Cleaning Patches
